clips.title: The story
paras: This errand directs Alliance adventurers in Stormwind to Tinker Town in Ironforge, where Tinkmaster Overspark is mourning a tragic malfunction. Brother Sarno sends word that Overspark's mechanical creation, Techbot, has gone rogue amidst the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan. Reaching the Tinkmaster is the first step toward recovering the wayward construct's memory core.

Brother Sarno, tending to travelers in Stormwind City, shares word of an unfortunate dilemma brewing among the gnomish refugees. Tinkmaster Overspark—one of the brilliant minds behind Gnomeregan's wonders—is distraught over the corruption of Techbot, a once-helpful mechanical servant that served the tinkerers faithfully before the city fell into ruin.

The quest dispatches helpful souls via the Deeprun Tram up into Ironforge's bustling enclave of Tinker Town. There, Overspark desperately seeks adventurers brave enough to plunge back into the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan to salvage what remains of Techbot's faculties before the construct causes irreparable harm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot. I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.
Very sad. But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!
Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge. He would welcome your help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes it's true. Techbot has gone rogue! Please, can you help me?
